integrations.name: OpenAI Codex Security
integrations.governance: Run only in a separately authorized, supported environment. SafeOpsAgent imports bounded summaries from pre-generated artifacts and never launches the CLI.

integrations.name: SkillGuard CLI
integrations.governance: Use the exact reviewed version in an isolated CI job. Reports require human review; runtime installation or execution by SafeOpsAgent is prohibited.

requirements: Record source, license and an exact reviewed version before adding an integration.
Do not mirror an entire site or automatically install tools discovered in catalog pages.
Do not run exploit, phishing, malware, credential attack or unauthorized reconnaissance tools.
Translate approved material into local defensive controls and deterministic regression cases only.
